function.name: request_followup
function.description: Record a follow-up for this call when booking can't complete, membership needs verification, an existing booking needs a change, tools keep failing (reason=technical_issue, after a stop_retrying result), or a customer who needs home heating/cooling service wants a person and no live transfer is available (reason=caller_requested, which also pages the dispatcher). caller_requested needs the caller's name and a confirmed callback number saved first (otherwise needs_details with missing), and is refused as out_of_scope for sales, vendor or non-HVAC calls: decline those politely and take no message. The call record is created from caller ID if nothing was saved yet. Only say a follow-up exists after status=recorded. A recorded result does NOT guarantee a callback time, transfer, or cancel an appointment. Never use it instead of emergency guidance. Any result that isn't a success has status, missing, expected (exact saved values to echo) and a one-sentence hint: follow the hint and never speak past it as if it worked.
